stories.title: Trump strikes a deal with Putin for Russian diesel, reversing years of sanctions pressure ahead of the midterms
stories.reason: The Treasury Department will temporarily waive sanctions on Russian energy through April 2027 so Moscow can ship millions of tons of diesel to ease US fuel prices, a stunning reversal that Zelensky called 'a weak decision' and that sits uneasily with sanctions law Trump signed only last month.

stories.title: Houthi missile strikes kill three, including an airline captain, at Riyadh's main airport
stories.reason: The Iran-backed group's attack on King Khalid International Airport damaged a Saudia jet and forced airlines to cancel flights to the capital, marking a sharp escalation just days after earlier strikes on Abha and King Khalid airports killed three civilians and wounded 36.

stories.title: The Palestinian Authority postpones its first legislative elections in 20 years
stories.reason: Vice President Hussein al-Sheikh told France the November 28 vote will be delayed for months, with officials recommending a reschedule to September 2027, after the PA concluded that deteriorating political, security and economic conditions made the election impossible to hold as planned.

stories.title: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro component orders as a $100 price hike dents demand
stories.reason: Suppliers are set to ship at least 15% fewer components this month after rising memory-chip costs pushed up the Pro and Pro Max price, sending Apple shares down 3% and dragging down chip suppliers Skyworks and Qualcomm.

stories.title: France suspends police use of stun grenades at student protests after a teenager loses a hand
stories.reason: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez ordered the pause pending an investigation into the injury to a 15-year-old in Lens, as Amnesty International calls for a permanent ban and PM Sebastien Lecornu promises the government's first decisions on the unrest by the end of October.

stories.title: Witnesses say Eritrean troops have entered northern Ethiopia as the Tigray conflict escalates
stories.reason: The unconfirmed sightings follow the TPLF's withdrawal from Tigray's capital Mekelle, with Ethiopia accusing Eritrea, Egypt and Sudan of backing the armed alliance seeking to oust PM Abiy Ahmed, raising fears the fighting could draw in the wider region and unravel the 2022 Pretoria ceasefire.

stories.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with an 'Intelligent UI' that turns ChatGPT answers into interactive tools
stories.reason: The update lets ChatGPT generate charts, calculators and small interactive apps alongside text, rolling out first to paid tiers before reaching free users, as OpenAI pushes beyond plain text answers to compete for everyday assistant use.

stories.title: Japan's household spending falls for a ninth straight month even as real wages keep rising
stories.reason: August spending dropped 3.1% year-on-year, a smaller decline than forecast but the ninth consecutive monthly fall despite eight straight months of real-wage gains, complicating the Bank of Japan's deliberations over further interest-rate increases.
